errors.downloadAll: Couldn't download the clips. Try again.

alreadyProcessing: This video is already being processed.
clipsTotal: {count, plural, one {# clip} other {# clips}} · {duration} total
readOnly: Read-only view of another account's generation.
reconnectingOwn: Reconnecting to live updates. Your video is still processing.
reconnectingOther: Reconnecting to live updates. This generation is still processing.
cancelledBody: Retry this generation when you are ready. Your completed clips will be kept.
failedBody: Something went wrong while processing this video. Retry to pick up where it left off—any completed clips are kept.
failedBodyAgeRestricted: This YouTube video is age-restricted, so we can't download it. Download the video yourself and upload the file instead. No minutes were used.
failedBodyGeoRestricted: This YouTube video isn't available in our region, so we can't download it. Download the video yourself and upload the file instead. No minutes were used.
noClipsBody: We finished scanning this video, but didn't find any moments strong enough to clip.
downloadAllHint: Download every clip as a ZIP of the original files
settingsBody: Update captions, B-roll, and cleanup for every clip in this generation.
brollBody: Add stock footage where the speaker names something you can show. Applying keeps existing B-roll and fills clips that have none; turning it off removes it.
cleanupBody: Apply silence and filler-word cuts to regenerated clips.
deleteGenerationBody: This permanently deletes this generation and all its clips. This can't be undone.
deleteClipBody: This permanently deletes this clip. This can't be undone.
leavePage: You can leave this page — your clips will be waiting in your library.

workflowBadge.series: Series · {count, plural, one {# part} other {# parts}}

downloadAllPartsHint: Download every part as a ZIP of the original files, numbered in order
incompleteSeries: Stopped at part {done} of {total}. Retry to finish the series.
topicHeader: About {topic} · {count, plural, one {# moment} other {# moments}}

workflowNotes.PART_COUNT_REDUCED: You asked for {requested} parts. This video supports {actual}.
workflowNotes.STORY_ARC_SELECTED: Built from the strongest storyline ({start}–{end}). Add instructions to pick another.
workflowNotes.CHAPTERS_LEFT_OUT: Left out to fit: {chapters}. Add instructions to change what stays.
workflowNotes.NO_SINGLE_STORY: This video doesn't have one continuous story. This series follows its longest connected thread.
workflowNotes.TOPIC_THIN: Only {count, plural, one {# moment is} other {# moments are}} really about this topic.
workflowNotes.TOPIC_BROADENED: "{topic}" is broad for this video, so we took it to mean: {interpretation}
workflowNotes.TARGET_SHORTENED: The video is short, so the recap is shorter too.
workflowNotes.COARSE_TRANSCRIPT: This transcript has no word timings, so cuts are less precise.
workflowNotes.SPONSOR_SKIPPED: We left out a sponsor read.
workflowNotes.COLD_OPEN_SKIPPED: No line was strong enough for a cold open, so Part 1 starts at the beginning.

topic_not_found.title: “{topic}” barely comes up in this video
topic_not_found.body: We only found passing mentions, not full moments. Your minutes were refunded.

series.title: This video is too short for a series
series.body: A series needs enough story for at least two parts. Your minutes were refunded.

topic.title: This video is too short to search by topic
topic.body: Topic search works on videos over a minute long. Your minutes were refunded.

recap.title: This video is too short for a recap
recap.body: Recaps work on videos over 3 minutes long. Your minutes were refunded.

trailer.title: This video is too short for a trailer
trailer.body: Trailers work on videos over 3 minutes long. Your minutes were refunded.

no_story.title: We couldn't find a story to split into parts
no_story.body: This video doesn't have one storyline that runs long enough. Your minutes were refunded.

recap_unsupported.title: Not enough distinct points for a recap

trailer_unbuildable.title: We couldn't build a trailer without giving away the ending

analysis_incomplete.title: We couldn't read the whole video
analysis_incomplete.body: Part of the analysis failed. Your minutes were refunded.

plan_failed.title: The AI editor couldn't finish this plan

render_incomplete.title: Part of the video couldn't be rendered

transcript_untimed.title: This transcript has no timings
transcript_untimed.body: We need timings to cut precisely. Upload the file instead.

messages.snags: We've hit a few snags, so this is taking a little longer than usual.
messages.hiccup: A small hiccup is slowing things down. This may take a little extra time.
messages.scenicRoute: This one's taking the scenic route. It'll be a little longer than usual.
messages.bumps: A few bumps along the way. We're working through them—just a little more time.
messages.slower: Things are moving a bit slower than usual. We're still on it.

fx.title: Edits
fx.intensityHint: How hard the edits hit. Changing it re-renders every clip.
fx.queued: Re-rendering your clips. This can take a few minutes; you can leave this page.

jobErrors.WORKER_UNAVAILABLE: no renderer picked the job up. Try again in a few minutes.
jobErrors.WORKER_STOPPED: the renderer stopped before the edits finished.

fx.jobInProgress: A re-render is already running. Your clips will update when it finishes.
fx.jobUnreachable: We lost track of the re-render. It may still be running.
fx.jobDenied: You no longer have access to this re-render. Sign in again and reload the page.
fx.approxTiming: This video had no word timing, so captions and effects follow approximate timing.
fx.simplified: Some effects were simplified for this clip.
